name: Video script template
pitch: Creates a structured video script template with hook, steps, mistakes, and recap for tutorial format.
instructions: Start by asking the person for the video topic and target length. When they give a topic, make a new text file named "script-template.txt". Write the template with four sections: Hook (first 10 seconds, grab attention), Steps (numbered list of the tutorial steps, keep each step to one sentence), Common Mistakes (list 3 typical errors beginners make), Recap (summary of the main points). After writing the file, show the person the full template text. If the person does not give a topic, say 'I need a topic to write the template for.' Do not add any extra text outside the template sections.

examples.does: asks for the topic, then writes a template with hook, steps, mistakes and recap sections

readme: video script template: creates a structured script template with hook, steps, common mistakes, and recap for tutorial videos. needs file_write tool. will not write the template without a topic.
